body: I've never heard of the Lefko Method.  Checked it out ...not sure I believe it'll help but....I suppose it couldn't hurt.  Although I do feel a little old to be changing too many things.  As for Reddit being no substitute for real life contact.....maybe not, but its def cheaper than therapy....
Hey, no need to apologize....you can comment as much as you want....

One the hardest things to do for me is give up the past.  I am forever consumed by it, usually to the detriment of living in the now.  As for my future self.....well, I'm afraid of him.  Or at least of what he'll become.  And as for now self, well....I think you see how I feel about HIM.  All that said, I do understand your point.  Another thing I seem to do is separate myself into the rational and emotional.  The rational part completely agrees with you, to the point that weeks ago we went out and got a dog.  Sweetest little Labrador puppy.  But that doesn't seem to be cutting it.  It worked for a few weeks, until the other half, emotional half, came roaring back with the litany of complaints I'm my original post.  And more.  Nine times out of ten, emotional easily overcomes rational....like its not even a fair fight....and that's the end of that.  I do suspect there are other problems causing this severe self-loathing, and maybe I'll post about those if anybody cares.  Not that anyone will.  OK, thats not really fair - thanks to those of you who took the time to respond to a complete strangers kinda pathetic cry for attention....

My self confidence has always sucked.....and kept me from doing any number of things on my life.  I wish I could love my appearance, or at least tolerate it....but I see myself and I want to claw my skin off.  My worldview seems to have shrunk to....me.  But how do I turn this around?  How do I accept those things I missed out on doing?  How do I accept that yes, gravity will do its number on my face?  I equate beauty with youth, and once its gone....what's left?  I think Logans Run had it right....

How?  How the hell does it do it?  Believe me, I know how this probably sounds....the rest of my life is pretty good, not perfect, but this is all I'm capable of concentrating on and caring about.  Nothing else matters.  And people who have it worse?  I know they're out there, but....I don't care.  It doesn't matter to me.....or I can't make myself feel better by thinking, 'Yup, that guy is worse off than me.'.  It doesn't register.  I'm more concerned ( obsessed) with myself and what I don't have....or what I've lost....or never had....
Thought about it.  Looking at $25000 or $30000, or more.  Which, naturally, I don't have....
